title: The Golem Who Drank the Heat
story: Deep in the Emberpit, Basalt the Lava Golem lumbered toward a village of stonecutters, glowing crust hissing. Mr 6 carried three frost-charges from the glacier monks, and a shield-crust that swallowed most of any chill. He decided to measure before he threw.
question: Each frost blast is worth 250 chill-points, but Basalt's crust blocks 40% of every blast, and his glowing crust holds 450 chill-points before it cools; how many frost blasts does Mr 6 need?
hint: If 40% is blocked, what percent of each 250-point blast actually gets through?
victory: Three blasts, exactly as counted — Basalt cooled into a friendly statue that now warms the stonecutters' soup pot. 'I didn't beat him,' Mr 6 shrugged. 'I just did the percentages.'
imagePrompt: A cracked, glowing lava golem in a red volcanic pit, frost mist curling off its shoulders as a small numeral-six knight with a sword and blue cape hurls a shimmering blue charge.
solution: If 40% is blocked, then 100% - 40% = 60% gets through, and 250 × 0.60 = 150 chill-points per blast.
Two blasts give 150 × 2 = 300, which is under 450, but three blasts give 150 × 3 = 450.
praise: Using the percent was smart thinking — the missing step was turning 40% blocked into 60% getting through.
